reported_quantity: Cramer-Rao LOWER BOUNDS on the standard deviation of a locally unbiased estimator at the nominal parameter value, under the assumed photon budget and likelihood. Not confidence intervals, not achieved estimator errors, and no claim that any estimator attains them.
span_definition: gaussian_equivalent_1p96_crlb_span is nominal +/- 1.96 sqrt(CRLB), a Gaussian-equivalent width for comparing the bound with the parameter's own scale. It is not a physical confidence interval and carries no coverage guarantee, so it may extend outside a parameter's physical range without that being a contradiction.

spectrum_cross_check.role: computational input, read and asserted against this recomputation

likelihood_selection.headline: multinomial_fixed_launch
likelihood_selection.basis: spec/baseline_spec.json profiles.production.likelihood, fixed in the spec before the CRLB was computed

coordinate_note: psi = D z, so a target with gradient c is (D c)^T z in the whitened coordinate

near_null.coordinate_note: the SVD of J_w = C^{-1/2} J_psi D gives right singular vectors in z, where psi = D z; the psi-space direction is the pushforward D v_z, left unnormalized so a unit step means unit displacement in z

geometry.near_null_coordinate_warning: the right singular vectors of J_w live in the scaled coordinate z, where psi = D z. Any step taken in psi space must use the pushforward D v_z. The earlier field name near_null_direction_psi_from_svd was wrong: it held v_z.

raw.crlb_omitted_because: the raw branch has no likelihood, so there is no Fisher information and no CRLB; only the geometric spectrum is meaningful

crlb.quantity: lower bound on the standard deviation of a locally unbiased estimator at the nominal parameter value, under the assumed photon budget and likelihood
crlb.method: C_z = V diag(1 / s^2) V^T from the SVD of J_w, then C_psi = D C_z D
crlb.correlation_meaning: local coupling of the bound at the nominal point: the directions in which the Fisher information fails to separate two parameters. It is a statement about this geometry and photon budget, not evidence that two absorption spectra are similar or that the two parameters share a single degree of freedom

estimability_aware_separate.note: reported as a curve; the headline bound is the full-rank one, because the numerical rank of J_w equals the number of parameters
estimability_aware_separate.warning: where a target has a discarded component its bound is infinite; the diagonal of a thresholded pseudo-inverse is a bound on the variance of the target's projection onto the retained subspace, a different estimand
